label: sprites/fw_spit.spr: a sludge spit that splashes, animated

R1.reason: The brief asks for a sludge spit that splashes. The frames show a soft cluster of bright blobs that swells and fades, reading more as a puff or small explosion than a splash with droplets flying off the impact. The sludge character is not evident.

R2.reason: The frames are 64 x 64 as the brief's sprite size requires. The effect fills the centre of each frame with margin on all sides and is not cropped at any edge, and the measured border is 0.004 max, so nothing is clipped.

R3.reason: The frames read as white to pale grey over the grey background, with no green-grey sludge tint visible. The brief's colour is grey-green with a pale belly, so this is clearly off. No colour measure was given, so this rests on the picture alone.

R4.reason: There are 8 frames, the right count, and the motion is a swell, bloom and fade ending dark (last 0, first 0). The envelope peaks at 0.14, at frame 1, against the explosion class's range of 0.22 to 0.71, so it peaks too soon. The measure already holds this item short of 2, so it cannot score 2.

R5.reason: The name fw_spit.spr is right, and the format (index alpha) and type (parallel) are recorded. The measures give no reference type or format for Half-Life's own sprites of this class, so I cannot confirm the type is the original's, and I score it short of 2 on that account.
